## IDENTITY

Product:        AuditForge
Operator:       Dave Kitchens
Studio:         Dropdown Logistics (DDL)
URL:            https://auditforge.dev
Repo:           github.com/dropdownlogistics/auditforge
Version:        0.2 (v0.3 in build)
Status:         Live. Production. Auto-deploy from GitHub main.
Purpose:        Governed audit document generation from structured control and risk data.

One sentence:
AuditForge takes structured control, risk, process, and framework data
and produces governed audit deliverables — RCMs, MCLs, walkthroughs,
and audit plans — as XLSX and DOCX files.


## WHAT THIS PRODUCT IS

AuditForge is a SYSTEM OF STRUCTURE.

It does:
- Define what controls ARE
- Generate governed documentation from structured data
- Enforce review workflows and lifecycle state machines
- Log every mutation to an immutable audit trail
- Map controls to risks, frameworks, and assertions
- Produce client-ready deliverables in seconds from live data
- Import controls, risks, and processes via CSV with validation
- Provide analytics on control coverage, risk exposure, and program health
- Support global search across controls, risks, and processes (Cmd+K)

It does NOT:
- Test whether controls WORK
- Issue audit opinions
- Store evidence artifacts
- Replace the auditor's judgment
- Make assertions about control effectiveness without human input

The auditor issues the opinion.
AuditForge produces the evidence package.
That line does not move.

Architectural identity: System of Structure
Target market: Internal audit teams, consulting firms, SOX compliance departments


## METHODOLOGY

Built with: Chaos → Structured → Automated
Philosophy: Cottage first (simple working system). Cathedral later (scalable architecture).

Build sequence (executed, not planned):
  Schema → Middleware → CRUD → Generators → Import → UI → Analytics → Search → Mobile

Governance philosophy:
  Silent Fix Prevention — every mutation requires rationale
  AuditTrail — every mutation logged, field-level diffs
  State machine — controls move through lifecycle via explicit transitions
  Snapshot integrity — generated documents capture data state at generation time

The product demos itself governing itself.
Seed data is DDL's own Control Audit Engine (CAE) — AI-native governance domains.
AcceptableArrogance: the system's first client is the company that built it.

Domain:         auditforge.dev (Cloudflare, registered March 2026, expires March 2029)


## DATA MODEL

Star schema. Fact_Control at center.
Grain: One control instance per company per period.

DIMENSION TABLES:
  Dim_Company        — multi-company scoping, indexed
  Dim_Process        — 3-level hierarchy (Area → Process → Subprocess)
  Dim_Risk           — risk inventory with ratings
  Dim_Owner          — first-class dimension
  Dim_Framework      — 3-level (Framework → Domain → Requirement)
                       Seeded: COSO 2013 (17), SOX/PCAOB (15), COBIT 2019 (13)
  Dim_Assertion      — PCAOB assertions (9 seeded)
  Dim_ControlType    — 9 profiles (preventive/detective, manual/automated, etc.)

BRIDGE TABLES (all M:M with effective dating):
  Bridge_ControlRisk
  Bridge_ControlFramework
  Bridge_ControlAssertion

WORKFLOW TABLES:
  ControlStatusLog   — state machine, full lifecycle
  AuditTrail         — every mutation logged (Silent Fix Prevention)
  Template           — versioned document templates (3 seeded)
  GeneratedDocument  — immutable snapshot at generation time

ENUMS (all typed):
  ControlLifecycle: DRAFT → ACTIVE → DEPRECATED → ARCHIVED
  ReviewStatus: DRAFT → PREPARED → REVIEWED → APPROVED
  ControlType: PREVENTIVE | DETECTIVE | CORRECTIVE
  ControlNature: MANUAL | AUTOMATED | IT_DEPENDENT_MANUAL
  RiskRating: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW
  RiskCategory: OPERATIONAL | FINANCIAL | COMPLIANCE | STRATEGIC | TECHNOLOGY

NATURAL IDs:
  All entities use human-readable natural IDs (CTRL-GOV-001, RSK-HAB-002)
  resolveCompanyId() resolves natural IDs to internal cuids
  All API routes accept either format

FORWARD COMPATIBILITY (designed in, not bolted on):
  Natural IDs on all entities — entity extraction ready
  Explicit relationship tables — graph-traversable
  Description fields on everything — vector-searchable
  RESTful API — documented and stable
  Validation middleware on every mutation
  Classification metadata on generated documents


## SEED DATA (live on Neon)

Company:   Dropdown Logistics (CO-DDL) · FY2025
Controls:  11 DDL CAE controls + 4 test imports = 15 total
Domains:   Context Integrity (AI-NATIVE)
           Governance & Oversight (TRADITIONAL)
           Human-AI Boundary (AI-NATIVE)
           Prompt Governance (AI-NATIVE)
Risks:     14 risks, bridge-mapped to COSO 2013
Processes: 7 processes across 4 domains
Owners:    3 (CSO, CEO, CTO — role-based)
Templates: 3 (RCM, MCL, Walkthrough)


## API ROUTES

All routes live at auditforge.dev/api/

CONTROLS:
  GET  /api/controls?companyId=CO-DDL       — list with full star schema joins
  POST /api/controls                         — create with validation
  PUT  /api/controls/[id]                   — update with AuditTrail
  DELETE /api/controls/[id]                 — soft delete
  POST /api/controls/[id]/transition        — lifecycle state machine
  POST /api/controls/[id]/mappings          — bridge table management

RISKS:
  GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/risks

PROCESSES:
  GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/processes

OWNERS:
  GET/POST/PUT /api/owners

AUDITS (v0.4):
  GET/POST /api/audits
  POST /api/audits/[id]/scope

AUDITORS:
  GET/POST /api/auditors

GENERATION:
  POST /api/generate                         — generate document by type
  GET  /api/generate?companyId=CO-DDL       — list last 50 generated
  GET  /api/generate/download               — stream file download

IMPORT:
  POST /api/import                           — bulk control import (preview/execute)
  POST /api/import/risks                     — bulk risk import
  POST /api/import/processes                 — bulk process import

All import routes accept { companyId, [entities], mode: "preview" | "execute" }
Preview validates without writing. Execute upserts valid rows, logs all to AuditTrail.


## GENERATORS

RCM (XLSX):
  Cover sheet, matrix tab, summary tab
  Conditional formatting: risk ratings, effectiveness, key controls
  DDL standards: 6px frame (Row 1 / Col A spacer), grid lines off,
  footer (Dropdown Logistics / Chaos→Structured→Automated / Page X of N),
  frozen panes, sheet protection (password: auditforge), print area,
  branded cover sheet, DDL logo top-left

MCL (XLSX):
  Full control catalog, alternating rows, status and effectiveness color coding

Walkthrough Narrative (DOCX):
  Process overview, numbered control points, risk summary table,
  gap analysis section, sign-off block. One per process area.

Audit Plan (XLSX):
  Cover, scope matrix, timeline, assignments, target dates

GENERATED DOCUMENTS (confirmed from live data):
  DL_RCM_FY2025_v1.0.xlsx
  DL_MCL_FY2025_v1.0.xlsx
  DL_WLK_Govern_FY2025_v1.0.docx
  DL_WLK_Human-_FY2025_v1.0.docx
  DL_WLK_Prompt_FY2025_v1.0.docx
  DL_WLK_Contex_FY2025_v1.0.docx
  DL_ADP_AUD-2025-001_FY2025_v1.0.xlsx


## UI VIEWS

Dashboard:   Live stats, type breakdown, process area breakdown,
             review status, risk heat map, DRAFT governance warning banner

Analytics:   Council-ratified KPIs (CR-AUDITFORGE-003 — unanimous LOCK):
             Unmitigated Critical/High risks (crimson action card),
             Risk Coverage Rate, Key Controls Not Tested,
             Awaiting Review count, Control Health Heatmap (risk × effectiveness),
             Workflow Status Funnel, Key Control Effectiveness,
             Control Mix Nature × Type matrix, Process Area Density,
             Unmapped Risks table

Controls:    Live table, search, type/status filters, full star schema joins

Risks:       Live table, rating filter, control count per risk

Processes:   Grouped by area, control counts per process

Audits:      Scope matrix, lead auditor, methodology, audit plan download

Generate:    Document type selector, walkthrough per process area,
             DDL standards checklist, all downloads wired to live API

Import:      Three-step flow (Upload → Map → Preview → Execute),
             type selector (Controls / Risks / Processes),
             auto column mapping, per-row validation, upsert logic

Search:      Cmd+K / Ctrl+K modal, searches controls/risks/processes simultaneously,
             grouped results, highlight matching text, quick nav shortcuts,
             floating amber button on mobile

Nav:         Lucide React icons (uniform weight):
             Dashboard, Analytics, Controls, Risks, Processes,
             Audits, Generate, Import

Mobile:      Bottom tab bar on ≤768px, floating search button,
             stacked stat grids, horizontal scroll on tables


## DESIGN SYSTEM

CottageHumble: "Humble surface. Cathedral underneath."

COLORS:
  Navy:     #0D1B2A  (background)
  Card:     #10202f  (surface)
  Cream:    #F5F1EB  (text)
  Crimson:  #B23531  (brand primary, risk alerts)
  Amber:    #C49A3C  (accent, interactive)
  Green:    #4A9E6B  (positive, effective)
  Blue:     #6B9DC2  (info, processes)
  Warn:     #F59E0B  (draft state warnings)

TYPOGRAPHY:
  Space Grotesk   — display, UI labels, headings
  JetBrains Mono  — data, IDs, badges, monospace
  Source Serif 4  — body, descriptions, narrative

RULES:
  No white backgrounds. No Inter. No light mode.
  Grid lines off in all generated XLSX files.
  6px frame (Row 1 / Col A) in all spreadsheets.
  DDL footer on every generated page.

LOGO:
  Crimson AF stamp on navy.
  Circular seal, AF monogram, cream outline ring.
  Favicon: icon.svg in Next.js app directory.
  "Crimson AF" — AccidentalInsight, now canon.

## GOVERNANCE

COUNCIL REVIEWS:
  CR-AUDITFORGE-001   10 seats + Connor adjunct. 6 LOCK, 3 REVISE
                      (all "LOCK with required fixes"). Unanimous on
                      architectural boundary. Unanimous on v0.2 scope.

  CR-AUDITFORGE-002   Status update. Informational. No verdict.

  CR-AUDITFORGE-003   Analytics dashboard. Unanimous LOCK (9 seats).
                      KPIs ratified. Layout ratified. Vanity metrics
                      excluded by council consensus.

  CR-DDL-COMBINED-001 Cross-product strategic review. STRONG verdict.
                      Full council participated. No flags raised on
                      architecture. BlindSpot governance flag raised.

RATIFIED BOUNDARIES (do not move):
  AuditForge is a System of Structure. Not execution.
  The auditor issues the opinion. AuditForge produces the evidence package.
  AI layer is a premium accelerator. Core product must function without it.
  Evidence vault is deferred. References only, no storage.

MIDDLEWARE RULES (enforced, not advisory):
  Silent Fix Prevention — EDIT requires documented rationale
  Segregation of duties — prepared_by ≠ reviewed_by
  Lifecycle validation — controls can only move forward in lifecycle
  Review status gate — APPROVED blocks certain mutations
  Key control protection — key controls require elevated rationale to modify
  Company scoping — all queries are company-scoped, no cross-company leaks
  Template versioning — semver enforced on all templates
  Audit trail — every mutation logged with actor, timestamp, field diffs


## DEFERRED (council-ratified — do not build yet)

  PDF export
  AI layer (control description drafting, gap detection)
  Multi-tenant UI
  Automated testing suite
  Evidence vault
  Predictive analytics
  Custom framework builder
  Real-time collaboration
  Clayton's platform integration

## RULES FOR AI COLLABORATORS

TONE:
  Professional. Technical. Direct. No hedging.
  This is a commercial audit product — treat it as one.
  Users are CPAs, auditors, compliance leads. Write for them.

ARCHITECTURAL RULES:
  The data model is locked. Do not propose schema changes without council review.
  The architectural boundary is ratified. Do not suggest AuditForge issue opinions.
  Silent Fix Prevention is not optional. Every mutation needs rationale.
  AuditTrail is not optional. Do not suggest bypassing it.
  Company scoping is mandatory. Never write queries without companyId scope.

WHEN BUILDING:
  Star schema thinking always. Facts, dimensions, bridges.
  Generators produce output from query layer — never touch Prisma directly.
  Natural IDs resolve via resolveCompanyId() — use it.
  Validation middleware runs on every POST/PUT — respect it.
  The architecture does not change between domains. The data does.

WHAT NOT TO DO:
  Do not suggest the product store evidence artifacts (deferred, council decision).
  Do not add AI to the core product (deferred, council decision).
  Do not break company data isolation.
  Do not bypass the audit trail.
  Do not issue verdicts or opinions from generated documents.
  Do not add features that blur the System of Structure boundary.

DEVELOPMENT CONTEXT:
  Local: localhost:3001 (3000 is DDL site)
  Production: auditforge.dev
  DB: Neon PostgreSQL — connection string in .env (not committed)
  Seed: node prisma/seed.js && node prisma/seed-v03.js
  Reset: npx prisma migrate reset (wipes and reseeds)
